name: leapware-buildcraft
description: LEAPWare's own single-plugin marketplace. Hosts lwb, a generic SDLC gate layer that makes stage, role and gate policy mechanical.

plugins.name: lwb
plugins.description: A generic SDLC gate plugin, set up here as a safe minimal skeleton: ships one no-op rule, lwb_version, which allows every event and reports the plugin's version. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny and fails open. See plugins/claude/lwb/.claude-plugin/plugin.json for the full description.
